portal_qs_cli_ci_pre: Non-interactive runners authenticate with a workspace automation key instead of a login — two environment variables and one command. Each run mints a short-lived gateway key (2 hours by default — tune with
portal_qs_cli_install_instructions: Linux and macOS: downloads the CLI from this gateway (sha256-verified) into ~/.local/bin.
portal_qs_cli_install_windows_instructio: Windows (PowerShell): downloads ssai.exe from this gateway (sha256-verified) into %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\ssai and adds it to your PATH. There is no sandbox on Windows: run clients with `ssai run --sandbox off <client>`. A gateway with a private certificate authority needs its root trusted by Windows first (your IT department, or certmgr.msc).
portal_qs_cli_intro_post: CLI provisions your installed AI tools in one go: it logs in through your browser, mints one workspace key, and merges the gateway config into each tool's own config file — your other settings are kept.
portal_qs_cli_login_instructions: Opens your browser to approve this device — works with password and SSO logins alike.
portal_qs_cli_provision_instructions: Detects your installed tools, mints one gateway key, and writes each config. Re-run any time; `ssai sync --watch` keeps configs converged.
portal_qs_cli_run_instructions: `ssai run <client>` launches a provisioned tool inside a native sandbox: its filesystem is confined to the current project directory and network egress is pinned to this gateway. Pass `--sandbox off` to run a client without confinement.
